description: This file contains a Smarty plugin defining the {html_checkboxes} function, which generates HTML checkbox inputs based on provided parameters. It includes functions to render checkboxes, handle parameters, and output HTML snippets for each checkbox, allowing customization such as labels, escaping, and selected options.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_checkboxes
methods.description: Main function to generate a list of HTML checkbox inputs based on parameters provided. It handles parameter parsing, options, and calls a helper to render each checkbox.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_checkboxes_output
methods.description: Helper function that constructs the HTML for an individual checkbox input, including label handling, escaping, and checked state.
